test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice marked with the numbers 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9 are shown. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the face having the number '9'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f75cc5410b701e452c333a313b43153201cd9b1fb6cccd4ff61682477dbde109.png]
solution:
Logic: If two dice have the same face value in the given image then their clockwise or anticlockwise wise number are known as opposite numbers in dice.

 ♦ If we rotate the second dice in a clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c016653a5f639659a018e9d3b03d41a14150db7db6c1780b6eb48e8997373fe4.png] 

We get,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54dacbbe5e9ab04b02ad6f9777c1f27e1a17fbdba0916016e2dcb19d60381dd8.png] 

In first dice and second dice.

The number '5' is common.

 ♦ The left letter will be opposite to each other writing them clockwise starting from 5.

 
 

 
 
**Number**

 
 
 
**Opposite**

 
 
 

 
 
9

 
 
 
7

 
 
 

 
 
8

 
 
 
6

 
 
 

 
 
5

 
 
 
4

 
 
 

Hence, the face opposite to the 9 is “7”.
